C0013.title: Shanghai Putuo Dismantles Criminal Gang Exploiting Fake Orders to Defraud Platform Subsidies
C0013.summary: In June 2025, China's Ministry of Public Security disclosed a Shanghai Putuo police case involving malicious fake orders to defraud platform subsidies. The criminal gang used network techniques to bypass platform controls, intruded into an enterprise internet platform backend, purchased large quantities of delisted coupons, and organized coupon brokers, order brushers, and merchants to obtain subsidies through fictitious transactions. Police arrested 15 suspects across the chain.
